title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Continuation run: the 4 default remote passes and 4 reachable-city hybrid passes not completed in the 2026-09-21 run. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 22, 2026 — completed the 4 remote keywords left over from 2026-09-21 (Staff DevOps Engineer, Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Senior Infrastructure Engineer), spot-re-verified DevOps Engineer (unchanged inventory), and ran all 4 remaining city passes (Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal). 2 new eligible postings filed (McKesson score 7, Genetec score 5); 3 new sub-5 rows and 1 new ineligible/1 new out-of-scope row logged for completeness; 1 posting could not be validated.

rows.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
rows.gap: Deep hands-on NGINX ingress-layer mastery and Ruby/Go programming are both explicitly required — Marc's languages are Python/Bash/C++/Java, not Ruby or Go. Kubernetes, Terraform/Ansible IaC, SLO/error-budget ownership, on-call/RCA practice, and observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog nice-to-have) all overlap well otherwise.

rows.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
rows.gap: Scored from the Eluta listing summary only — the inline expansion didn't reliably open for this posting despite repeated attempts, so full requirements (in particular any hard GCP/AWS ownership bar) are unconfirmed. What the summary shows is a strong match: GCP/AWS infrastructure ownership, ArgoCD/Helm/GitHub Actions platform tooling, observability and incident response across regulated jurisdictions (sports betting).

rows.title: Senior Lead Engineer, Platform Operations & Observability / Ingénieur principal, Opérations de plateforme et observabilité
rows.location: Saint-Laurent (Montréal), QC — hybrid, 2 days/week mandatory (Mon/Wed) at the Dobrin office
rows.gap: Range's low end sits below the $120k Montréal hybrid-FTE floor, but the top clears it comfortably and 7+ years SRE/Platform/DevOps seniority plus healthcare-regulated scope argues for upper-range placement — confirm in conversation. Otherwise an excellent match: incident management/RCA/MTTR ownership, CI/CD and change governance, Dynatrace explicitly preferred (direct Desjardins overlap), Azure/Kubernetes preferred, technical leadership and mentorship without formal people-management — mirrors Marc's 'leads without authority' positioning.

rows.title: Ingénieur(e) DevOps / DevOps Engineer - Dynamics 365 & Azure DevOps
rows.location: Montréal, QC — office cadence not stated (free on-site parking/gym mentioned, but no explicit days/week; treat as hybrid pending confirmation)
rows.gap: Strong Azure DevOps administration/CI-CD/IaC (Terraform, Bicep, ARM) overlap with Marc's depth, but the role is Dynamics 365 F&O/CE- and Power Platform/Dataverse-specific — Marc has no D365 exposure, a real gap against a '5+ years D365 DevOps' bar. Bilingual FR/EN requirement is a Marc strength.

rows.title: DevOps Engineer - BTP Site Reliability Engineering team
rows.gap: 3 days/week on-site needs a well-above-target rate to be worth it per profile.md's reachable-city rule; $95-135K doesn't clear that bar (barely reaches the $120k Montréal floor at the very top). Otherwise a real skill match: Kubernetes, Linux, CI/CD, multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Python/Go/Bash. Not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization — irrelevant to Marc as a Canadian citizen/resident.

rows.title: DevOps Engineer (Cloud Infrastructure)
rows.location: Montréal, QC — described as "digital-first" with flexible/hybrid offices; exact days/week not stated
rows.gap: Heavily AWS-centric ("complex, hybrid architectures" on AWS) with no Azure mention — Marc's AWS story is dated and by-hand, no IaC, a weak answer if AWS ownership is the actual deliverable here. Tecsys already has a separate, different-req Site Reliability Engineer posting Applied via Glassdoor (2026-09-19) — same employer, distinct role, not a duplicate.

rows.title: Staff Engineer, Site Reliability
rows.gap: Hard AWS-ownership-at-scale gate: "deep hands-on Terraform expertise" as IaC owner, "proven AWS experience at scale" (EKS, RDS, networking, DNS, CDNs), and production Kubernetes debugging are all explicit musts. No Azure mentioned at all — Marc's dated, by-hand, non-IaC AWS experience doesn't clear this bar.

rows.title: Site Reliability Engineer
rows.location: Work Remotely — posting states "anticipated that this position will be performed outside of Ontario"
rows.gap: Explicit statement that the role will be performed outside Ontario — Marc is based in Smiths Falls, ON, so this is a hard geographic eligibility gate against him specifically, the inverse of the usual residency-requirement rule. Otherwise a strong skill match (SLIs/SLOs, Kubernetes, Datadog/Grafana/Elastic, Python/Bash, Azure-preferred) — the gate alone rules it out.

rows.title: Manager, Fixed Wireless New Technology & Performance
rows.status: Out of scope — telecom RF/fixed-wireless engineering management, not DevOps/SRE/Platform IC work
rows.gap: Title mentions a DevOps team the role partners with, but the job itself is network-performance/RF engineering management for fixed wireless technology — wrong domain and a people-management scope, not an IC infrastructure role.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Eluta's result pages now show a real snippet directly in search results (a change from prior runs) and, for most postings, an inline "Show more" expansion that reveals the full posting without needing the cache-link workaround — used successfully for Braze and Kinaxis. It did not work reliably for every posting (theScore), consistent with prior runs' documented unreliability; scored from the listing summary in that case per established practice in this repo's history.

Ran DevOps Engineer, Senior DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, and Infrastructure Engineer as remote-filtered passes, plus one Ottawa city pass (unfiltered by remote, since hybrid discovery intentionally doesn't use the remote filter). Stopped there given the scope already covered today across 8 other boards — the remaining 4 remote keywords and 4 city passes (Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal) are a reasonable next-run target, not run this time.

"Cloud Engineer" and "Infrastructure Engineer" are both extremely broad terms on this site (695 and 728 total results respectively) — only the first page of each was reviewed, consistent with the skill's 10-result-per-query boundary.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
